notFound.title: Invalid invitation
notFound.description: The invitation link you opened is invalid or was not found.

expired.title: Invitation expired
expired.description: This invitation has expired and can no longer be used.
expired.notice: This invitation has expired. Ask the administrator to send a new invitation.

revoked.title: Invitation revoked
revoked.description: This invitation was canceled by an administrator.
revoked.notice: This invitation was revoked by an administrator.

accepted.title: Invitation already accepted
accepted.description: This invitation has already been used.
accepted.notice: You have already accepted this invitation.

mismatch.title: Different recipient
mismatch.description: You are signed in with a different account from the one the invitation was sent to.
mismatch.notice: This invitation was sent to another email.
mismatch.hint: You are signed in as {email}. To accept this invitation, sign out of this account and sign in with the invited email.

unconfirmed.title: Email not confirmed
unconfirmed.notice: Your email must be confirmed to accept the invitation.

valid.title: Team invitation
valid.description: You have been invited to join an organization.

status.accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
status.recipientMismatch: This invitation was sent to another email. Sign in with the invited account.
status.emailUnconfirmed: Your email must be confirmed to accept the invitation.

partner.title: Join {partner}
partner.description: You were invited as {role}. After accepting, use the partner console at /admin on the partner domain.
